alchemy.name: Minor Healing Potion
alchemy.description: A humble draught of crushed herbs and spring water. It mends shallow wounds—nothing more, nothing less.

alchemy.name: Minor Mana Potion
alchemy.description: Spirit-flower petals dissolved in still water. The faint shimmer restores a wisp of spent mana.

alchemy.name: Healing Potion
alchemy.description: Medicinal herbs distilled into a potent restorative. Soldiers trade coin for these before the march.

alchemy.name: Antidote
alchemy.description: Charcoal and bitter herb pressed into a tar-black liquid. It burns the poison out before it can settle.

alchemy.name: Mind Focus Elixir
alchemy.description: Arcane dust suspended in spirit-flower extract sharpens thought to a razor's edge. The clarity fades, but the spells cast under its influence do not.

alchemy.name: Aurora Flux
alchemy.description: Void essence braided with ancient root and prismatic powder. The drinker's veins glow briefly as body and mana knit themselves whole under elemental fury.

alchemy.name: Basic Potion
alchemy.description: A cloudy vial of herb-water that soothes minor aches. Every alchemist starts here.

alchemy.name: Basic Elixir
alchemy.description: A thin, bitter liquid that barely qualifies as alchemy. Functional, if unremarkable.

alchemy.name: Basic Tonic
alchemy.description: A crude tonic that tastes like wet grass. It works, barely.

alchemy.name: Basic Catalyst
alchemy.description: Ground herbs pressed into a reactive paste. It accelerates simpler reactions.

alchemy.name: Sturdy Potion
alchemy.description: A reliable restorative brewed from medicinal-grade herbs. Field medics swear by it.

alchemy.name: Sturdy Elixir
alchemy.description: Properly steeped medicinal herbs yield this dependable elixir. Worth more than its ingredients.

alchemy.name: Sturdy Tonic
alchemy.description: Medicinal herbs steeped long enough to matter. A journeyman alchemist's bread and butter.

alchemy.name: Sturdy Catalyst
alchemy.description: Medicinal compounds refined into a stable catalyst. Reliable as a heartbeat.

alchemy.name: Enchanted Potion
alchemy.description: Spirit-flower essence stabilized with arcane dust. The liquid hums faintly when uncorked.

alchemy.name: Enchanted Elixir
alchemy.description: Arcane resonance hums through every drop. The drinker feels the effect before it touches their lips.

alchemy.name: Enchanted Tonic
alchemy.description: Spirit-flower and arcane dust produce a tonic that sharpens senses and steadies hands.

alchemy.name: Enchanted Catalyst
alchemy.description: Arcane-infused catalyst that makes lesser reagents behave as though they were rare. Dangerous in careless hands.

alchemy.name: Masterwork Potion
alchemy.description: Ancient roots surrendered their essence reluctantly for this brew. Drink carefully—the body remembers.

alchemy.name: Masterwork Elixir
alchemy.description: Brewed from ancient roots and spirit essence, this elixir tastes like old forests and quiet power.

alchemy.name: Masterwork Tonic
alchemy.description: Ancient root tonic brewed to a formula only master alchemists dare attempt. Side effects vary.

alchemy.name: Masterwork Catalyst
alchemy.description: Spirit essence bound into catalyst form. Other compounds bend around it like water around a stone.

alchemy.name: Mythic Potion
alchemy.description: Void-touched elixir distilled under conditions most alchemists consider suicidal. Heals what lesser draughts cannot.

alchemy.name: Mythic Elixir
alchemy.description: The void bleeds into the glass. Primordial and rare essences merge into something that rewrites the drinker's limits.

alchemy.name: Mythic Tonic
alchemy.description: Void-essence tonic that pulses with primordial energy. The last tonic many alchemists ever need to make.

alchemy.name: Mythic Catalyst
alchemy.description: Primordial forces compressed into a catalyst that treats natural law as a suggestion. Handle with reverence.

blacksmithing.name: Iron Ingot
blacksmithing.description: Raw ore beaten into a serviceable bar. The foundation of every smith's first lesson.

blacksmithing.name: Iron Dagger
blacksmithing.description: A short blade of hammered iron. Cheap, sharp enough, and easy to hide.

blacksmithing.name: Iron Chainmail
blacksmithing.description: Interlocking iron rings woven by patient hands. Stops a blade; slows its wearer.

blacksmithing.name: Steel Ingot
blacksmithing.description: Iron and coal married under terrible heat. The resulting steel holds an edge worth respecting.

blacksmithing.name: Steel Sword
blacksmithing.description: A proper weapon of folded steel and leather grip. Soldiers kill for less.

blacksmithing.name: Mythril Ingot
blacksmithing.description: Mythril ore refined with spirit essence. The bar weighs less than it should and hums when struck.

blacksmithing.name: Mythril Blade
blacksmithing.description: Five mythril ingots and enchanted leather produce a blade that cuts reality a little thinner than iron ever could.

blacksmithing.name: Soulforged Helmet
blacksmithing.description: Adamantine plate shaped around a soul gem. The wearer hears a faint whisper that might be protection—or might be something older.

blacksmithing.name: Basic Blade
blacksmithing.description: Hammered iron sharpened on a whetstone. A beginner's weapon, but a weapon nonetheless.

blacksmithing.name: Basic Shield
blacksmithing.description: A flat iron slab with a leather strap. It stops what it can.

blacksmithing.name: Basic Armor
blacksmithing.description: Crude iron plates riveted over leather. Protection measured in bruises avoided.

blacksmithing.name: Basic Tool
blacksmithing.description: A simple iron implement. It won't impress anyone, but it does the job.

blacksmithing.name: Sturdy Blade
blacksmithing.description: Steel tempered in coal-fire. The edge holds through punishment that would shatter lesser metal.

blacksmithing.name: Sturdy Shield
blacksmithing.description: Steel-braced and properly weighted. A journeyman shield that earns trust through use.

blacksmithing.name: Sturdy Armor
blacksmithing.description: Steel plate fitted by a competent hand. Not elegant, but your organs stay inside.

blacksmithing.name: Sturdy Tool
blacksmithing.description: Steel-grade toolwork with a comfortable grip. Built to outlast its owner.

blacksmithing.name: Enchanted Blade
blacksmithing.description: Mythril-forged and arcane-dusted, this blade seems to anticipate where it's swung.

blacksmithing.name: Enchanted Shield
blacksmithing.description: Mythril alloy reinforced with arcane dust. Blows land softer than physics should allow.

blacksmithing.name: Enchanted Armor
blacksmithing.description: Mythril links woven with arcane binding. Light as resolve, hard as consequence.

blacksmithing.name: Enchanted Tool
blacksmithing.description: Mythril-tipped and arcane-balanced. Work done with this tool feels less like labor.

blacksmithing.name: Masterwork Blade
blacksmithing.description: Adamantine and spirit essence fused under a master's hammer. The metal remembers violence and answers it.

blacksmithing.name: Masterwork Shield
blacksmithing.description: Adamantine-core shield infused with spirit essence. Arrows have been known to apologize mid-flight.

blacksmithing.name: Masterwork Armor
blacksmithing.description: Adamantine plate kissed by spirit essence. Master smiths consider it their signature—or their tombstone.

blacksmithing.name: Masterwork Tool
blacksmithing.description: Adamantine precision shaped by spirit essence. The tool almost seems to know what you need next.

blacksmithing.name: Mythic Blade
blacksmithing.description: Divine metal folded with primordial essence. Legends rarely mention how many smiths died perfecting the technique.

blacksmithing.name: Mythic Shield
blacksmithing.description: Divine metal bonded with primordial force. The shield doesn't block attacks—it denies them permission.

blacksmithing.name: Mythic Armor
blacksmithing.description: Divine metal armor that reshapes itself around the wearer's intent. The primordial essence inside has opinions.

blacksmithing.name: Mythic Tool
blacksmithing.description: Divine metal wrought into something that treats craftsmanship as a form of prayer. Primordial essence hums in the handle.

brewing.name: Basic Ale
brewing.description: Thin grain-ale that tastes like ambition and water. A brewer's first attempt.

brewing.name: Basic Wine
brewing.description: Grain pressed and fermented with more hope than skill. Barely qualifies as wine.

brewing.name: Basic Tonic
brewing.description: Grain-based tonic with a medicinal aftertaste. Cheap and necessary.

brewing.name: Basic Elixir
brewing.description: A grain-based elixir barely distinguishable from flavored water. Progress starts somewhere.

brewing.name: Sturdy Ale
brewing.description: Fruit-fermented ale with enough body to warm a cold night's watch.

brewing.name: Sturdy Wine
brewing.description: Fruit-wine with a clean finish. Popular at taverns that care about repeat customers.

brewing.name: Sturdy Tonic
brewing.description: Fruit-fermented tonic refined for potency. Keeps explorers on their feet.

brewing.name: Sturdy Elixir
brewing.description: Fruit-derived elixir with a steadying warmth. Adventurers carry these like ritual.

brewing.name: Enchanted Ale
brewing.description: Spirit-flower and arcane dust produce an ale that changes color as you drink it.

brewing.name: Enchanted Wine
brewing.description: Arcane-touched vintage that sparkles with trapped starlight. Sommeliers weep.

brewing.name: Enchanted Tonic
brewing.description: Arcane resonance laced through every drop. The body absorbs it before the tongue can object.

brewing.name: Enchanted Elixir
brewing.description: Arcane-laced elixir brewed from spirit-flower. The effect lingers longer than expected.

brewing.name: Masterwork Ale
brewing.description: Void essence steeped in aged barrels. The flavor profile exists in more dimensions than expected.

brewing.name: Masterwork Wine
brewing.description: Void-essence wine aged beyond mortal patience. Each glass tastes like a memory you haven't made yet.

brewing.name: Masterwork Tonic
brewing.description: Void-steeped tonic that recalibrates the drinker's stamina. Side effects include unsettling clarity.

brewing.name: Masterwork Elixir
brewing.description: Void essence and spirit-infused elixir that tastes like standing in a thunderstorm. For the better.

brewing.name: Mythic Ale
brewing.description: Divine nectar brewed with primordial patience. One sip rearranges the drinker's understanding of thirst.

brewing.name: Mythic Wine
brewing.description: Primordial vintage distilled from divine nectar. Drinking it is closer to communion than consumption.

brewing.name: Mythic Tonic
brewing.description: Primordial tonic that treats exhaustion as a negotiable condition. Divine nectar demands respect.

brewing.name: Mythic Elixir
brewing.description: Divine nectar and primordial essence merge into an elixir that rewrites fatigue at the cellular level.

butchery.name: Basic Cured Meat
butchery.description: Salt-rubbed meat hung to dry. Simple preservation for a simple road.

butchery.name: Basic Jerky
butchery.description: Thin-sliced meat dried over smoke. Trail food that demands nothing and delivers enough.

butchery.name: Basic Sausage
butchery.description: Rough-ground meat stuffed into casing. Don't ask questions; eat it.

butchery.name: Basic Ration
butchery.description: Compressed meat and grain pressed into a block. It sustains; it does not inspire.

butchery.name: Sturdy Cured Meat
butchery.description: Prime cuts cured with care and time. Keeps longer, tastes better, costs more.

butchery.name: Sturdy Jerky
butchery.description: Prime jerky with a peppered bite. Reliable fuel for long marches.

butchery.name: Sturdy Sausage
butchery.description: Prime meat sausage seasoned with intent. The casing holds better things now.

butchery.name: Sturdy Ration
butchery.description: Prime rations packed for extended campaigns. Reliable as gravity.

butchery.name: Enchanted Cured Meat
butchery.description: Exotic meat treated with arcane salt. The preservation borders on unnatural.

butchery.name: Enchanted Jerky
butchery.description: Arcane-smoked exotic jerky that sustains beyond what nutrition explains.

butchery.name: Enchanted Sausage
butchery.description: Exotic meat sausage laced with arcane spice. Hunger remembers this and behaves.

butchery.name: Enchanted Ration
butchery.description: Arcane-preserved exotic rations that stay fresh longer than trust.

butchery.name: Masterwork Cured Meat
butchery.description: Dragon steak cured with spirit essence. The meat resists spoilage like it resists everything else.

butchery.name: Masterwork Jerky
butchery.description: Dragon-strip jerky infused with spirit essence. Chewing it feels like an argument you're winning.

butchery.name: Masterwork Sausage
butchery.description: Dragon-meat sausage bound with spirit essence. The filling has an opinion about being eaten.

butchery.name: Masterwork Ration
butchery.description: Dragon-meat rations wrapped in spirit essence. They weigh less than they should and last longer than they have any right to.

butchery.name: Mythic Cured Meat
butchery.description: Divine flesh preserved through primordial technique. It tastes like a covenant.

butchery.name: Mythic Jerky
butchery.description: Divine flesh jerky touched by primordial fire. Each strip holds more sustenance than a full meal of lesser meat.

butchery.name: Mythic Sausage
butchery.description: Divine flesh sausage packed with primordial seasoning. Every bite is an event.

butchery.name: Mythic Ration
butchery.description: Divine-flesh rations infused with primordial staying power. An army could march on these until the world ended.

construction.name: Basic Wall
construction.description: Timber stacked and nailed. It keeps weather out and little else.

construction.name: Basic Gate
construction.description: A timber gate held by iron hinges. It swings open and closed—the rest is up to you.

construction.name: Basic Tower
construction.description: A timber watchtower. It gives you height and a better view of approaching problems.

construction.name: Basic Workshop
construction.description: A timber shed with a workbench. Ambition required; space provided.

construction.name: Sturdy Wall
construction.description: Stone-block wall with mortar joints. Siege engineers treat these with respect.

construction.name: Sturdy Gate
construction.description: Stone-framed gate with reinforced crossbar. Keeps honest threats honest.

construction.name: Sturdy Tower
construction.description: Stone-block tower built for permanence. Archers love the sightlines.

construction.name: Sturdy Workshop
construction.description: Stone-block workshop with ventilation and tool racks. Craft improves when the workspace doesn't fight you.

construction.name: Enchanted Wall
construction.description: Reinforced brick fused with arcane dust. The wall shifts subtly to distribute force.

construction.name: Enchanted Gate
construction.description: Arcane-warded gate of reinforced brick. Unauthorized entry triggers consequences.

construction.name: Enchanted Tower
construction.description: Reinforced brick tower humming with arcane ward-lines. Threats are spotted before they're visible.

construction.name: Enchanted Workshop
construction.description: Arcane-reinforced workshop where materials behave more predictably than they should.

construction.name: Masterwork Wall
construction.description: Enchanted masonry bonded with spirit essence. Battering rams break before this does.

construction.name: Masterwork Gate
construction.description: Enchanted masonry gate sealed with spirit essence. Opening it requires permission, not force.

construction.name: Masterwork Tower
construction.description: Enchanted masonry spire saturated with spirit essence. The tower sees what sentries miss.

construction.name: Masterwork Workshop
construction.description: Enchanted masonry workshop flooded with spirit-tuned air. Projects finish faster inside these walls.

construction.name: Mythic Wall
construction.description: Void-structure wall threaded with primordial will. It exists more firmly than the ground beneath it.

construction.name: Mythic Gate
construction.description: Void-structure gateway infused with primordial authority. Only passage granted by intent can cross its threshold.

construction.name: Mythic Tower
construction.description: Void-structure tower anchored in primordial geometry. Distance becomes negotiable from its apex.

construction.name: Mythic Workshop
construction.description: Void-structure workshop stabilized by primordial forces. The laws of materials bend gently to accommodate the crafter's will.

cooking.name: Simple Meal
cooking.description: Meat and vegetables over an open flame. It fills the belly and quiets the road's complaints.

cooking.name: Bread
cooking.description: Flour and water shaped by heat into something that turns strangers into guests.

cooking.name: Hearty Stew
cooking.description: Prime meat, vegetables, and spices simmered until comfort becomes inevitable. Soldiers call it morale in a bowl.

cooking.name: Basic Meal
cooking.description: Rough-cut meat charred over flame. Nourishment without pretense.

cooking.name: Basic Stew
cooking.description: Meat boiled until tenderness surrenders. Simple, hot, honest.

cooking.name: Basic Skewer
cooking.description: Chunks of meat impaled on a stick and held over fire. Tradition at its simplest.

cooking.name: Basic Dessert
cooking.description: Sweet scraps shaped into something that passes for celebration. Morale counts.

cooking.name: Sturdy Meal
cooking.description: Prime cuts prepared with care. A meal worth coming home to.

cooking.name: Sturdy Stew
cooking.description: Prime ingredients slow-cooked into a stew that makes cold camps bearable.

cooking.name: Sturdy Skewer
cooking.description: Prime meat skewered and flame-kissed. Quick to prepare, satisfying to eat.

cooking.name: Sturdy Dessert
cooking.description: Prime ingredients assembled into a dessert worth rationing. A treat between battles.

cooking.name: Enchanted Meal
cooking.description: Arcane-spiced fare that satisfies hungers the body didn't know it had.

cooking.name: Enchanted Stew
cooking.description: Arcane-seasoned stew that warms from the inside and lingers long after the bowl is empty.

cooking.name: Enchanted Skewer
cooking.description: Arcane-marinated skewers that crackle with residual heat long after leaving the fire.

cooking.name: Enchanted Dessert
cooking.description: Arcane-sweetened confection that lingers on the tongue and sharpens the senses.

cooking.name: Masterwork Meal
cooking.description: Rare herbs and spirit essence folded into a meal that restores more than strength.

cooking.name: Masterwork Stew
cooking.description: Spirit-touched stew brewed from rare herbs. The aroma alone has restorative properties.

cooking.name: Masterwork Skewer
cooking.description: Rare herb–basted skewers infused with spirit essence. The char carries flavor into the soul.

cooking.name: Masterwork Dessert
cooking.description: Spirit-essence dessert made from rare herbs. Sweetness with consequences.

cooking.name: Mythic Meal
cooking.description: Divine-flesh cuisine prepared with primordial technique. Eating it is an experience that redefines sustenance.

cooking.name: Mythic Stew
cooking.description: Divine flesh simmered in primordial broth. Each spoonful fills something deeper than the stomach.

cooking.name: Mythic Skewer
cooking.description: Divine-flesh skewers glazed with primordial reduction. Every bite echoes.

cooking.name: Mythic Dessert
cooking.description: Divine confection touched by primordial sugar. The taste outlives the meal by hours.

dyeing.name: Basic Dye
dyeing.description: Crude pigment mixed from common sources. The color holds until the first hard rain.

dyeing.name: Basic Pattern
dyeing.description: A simple repeating motif stitched or stamped with basic dye. Recognizable, if unremarkable.

dyeing.name: Basic Glamour
dyeing.description: A thin veneer of dye that adds a hint of color. Cosmetic, not transformative.

dyeing.name: Basic Finish
dyeing.description: A basic topcoat of dye that protects against scuffing. Modest in purpose.

dyeing.name: Sturdy Dye
dyeing.description: Metallic pigment ground and set with fixative. Colors that survive what the wearer survives.

dyeing.name: Sturdy Pattern
dyeing.description: Metallic-pigment pattern with clean geometry. Signals competence before the wearer speaks.

dyeing.name: Sturdy Glamour
dyeing.description: Metallic-pigment glamour that lends armor and cloth a polished authority.

dyeing.name: Sturdy Finish
dyeing.description: Metallic-pigment finish with a durable sheen. Weatherproof and presentable.

dyeing.name: Enchanted Dye
dyeing.description: Prismatic pigment fused with arcane dust. The dye shifts hue depending on the light—and the viewer's intent.

dyeing.name: Enchanted Pattern
dyeing.description: Prismatic pattern woven with arcane precision. It catches the eye and refuses to let go.

dyeing.name: Enchanted Glamour
dyeing.description: Prismatic glamour enhanced with arcane shimmer. The wearer looks more expensive than they are.

dyeing.name: Enchanted Finish
dyeing.description: Prismatic finish bonded with arcane dust. The surface repels grime and hostile scrutiny.

dyeing.name: Masterwork Dye
dyeing.description: Illusion dust bound with spirit essence into a dye that remembers every color it has ever been.

dyeing.name: Masterwork Pattern
dyeing.description: Illusion-dust pattern layered with spirit essence. The motif appears to move when observed closely.

dyeing.name: Masterwork Glamour
dyeing.description: Illusion-dust glamour fused with spirit essence. Onlookers remember the impression, not the details.

dyeing.name: Masterwork Finish
dyeing.description: Illusion-dust finish sealed by spirit essence. The coating adapts to conditions others can't predict.

dyeing.name: Mythic Dye
dyeing.description: Divine radiance distilled into pigment. The color applied is less a choice and more a statement of cosmic preference.

dyeing.name: Mythic Pattern
dyeing.description: Divine-radiance pattern sealed with primordial authority. The design tells a story that changes for every observer.

dyeing.name: Mythic Glamour
dyeing.description: Divine-radiance glamour infused with primordial presence. The wearer commands attention without speaking.

dyeing.name: Mythic Finish
dyeing.description: Divine-radiance finish over primordial sealant. The surface exists in a state of curated perfection.

enchanting.name: Mindshield Charm
enchanting.description: Silver ring inscribed with wisdom-essence and arcane ink. The wearer's thoughts become difficult to read and harder to manipulate.

enchanting.name: Stormbrand Enchant
enchanting.description: Mythril blade wired with lightning core and soulthread. The enchantment doesn't just add damage—it makes the weapon angry.

enchanting.name: Basic Rune
enchanting.description: Arcane ink pressed into a simple shape. The rune holds barely enough power to matter.

enchanting.name: Basic Sigil
enchanting.description: A faint arcane-ink sigil that warns more than it protects. A starting point.

enchanting.name: Basic Ward
enchanting.description: A basic arcane-ink ward scratched into a surface. It discourages; it does not prevent.

enchanting.name: Basic Charm
enchanting.description: Arcane-ink charm with a single-purpose enchantment. Modest, but it works.

enchanting.name: Sturdy Rune
enchanting.description: Elemental shard ground into rune-form. The inscription flickers with contained force.

enchanting.name: Sturdy Sigil
enchanting.description: Elemental-shard sigil with sharp lines of contained power. Respectable ward-work.

enchanting.name: Sturdy Ward
enchanting.description: Elemental-shard ward with layered defensive geometry. Adequate protection for moderate threats.

enchanting.name: Sturdy Charm
enchanting.description: Elemental-shard charm that hums quietly against the skin. Steady, reliable enhancement.

enchanting.name: Enchanted Rune
enchanting.description: Soul gem carved into a rune that pulses with arcane awareness. It knows when it's needed.

enchanting.name: Enchanted Sigil
enchanting.description: Soul-gem sigil pulsing with arcane authority. Hostile magic hesitates at its border.

enchanting.name: Enchanted Ward
enchanting.description: Soul-gem ward fused with arcane dust. Attacks that reach it lose their conviction.

enchanting.name: Enchanted Charm
enchanting.description: Soul-gem charm radiating arcane warmth. The enchantment adjusts subtly to its bearer.

enchanting.name: Masterwork Rune
enchanting.description: Void essence channeled into a master-grade rune. The inscription seems to watch back.

enchanting.name: Masterwork Sigil
enchanting.description: Void-essence sigil drawn with spirit precision. The mark burns cold in the presence of danger.

enchanting.name: Masterwork Ward
enchanting.description: Void-essence ward reinforced by spirit binding. Breaching it costs more than most aggressors can afford.

enchanting.name: Masterwork Charm
enchanting.description: Void-essence charm fused with spirit resonance. The charm seems to anticipate what the wearer will face.

enchanting.name: Mythic Rune
enchanting.description: Primordial rune etched with divine intent. Reality treats the marked surface differently.

enchanting.name: Mythic Sigil
enchanting.description: Primordial sigil of divine geometry. The pattern existed before the surface it's drawn on.

enchanting.name: Mythic Ward
enchanting.description: Primordial ward sealed with divine authority. What it protects stays protected until the ward decides otherwise.

enchanting.name: Mythic Charm
enchanting.description: Primordial charm of divine craftsmanship. The enchantment woven into it predates the jeweler's intent.

engineering.name: Basic Bomb
engineering.description: Scrap casing packed with volatile powder. Throw it and hope your arm is faster than the fuse.

engineering.name: Basic Turret
engineering.description: A scrap-metal turret that tracks movement with mechanical delay. Better than nothing.

engineering.name: Basic Gadget
engineering.description: A handheld thing made of scrap and optimism. Surprisingly useful.

engineering.name: Basic Automaton
engineering.description: A crude articulated figure of scrap metal. It follows basic instructions, mostly.

engineering.name: Sturdy Bomb
engineering.description: Alloy-shell bomb with a measured blast radius. Predictable destruction is still destruction.

engineering.name: Sturdy Turret
engineering.description: Alloy turret with reliable tracking servos. It watches the perimeter so you don't have to.

engineering.name: Sturdy Gadget
engineering.description: Alloy gadget with moving parts that actually move the way intended.

engineering.name: Sturdy Automaton
engineering.description: Alloy automaton with reliable servo-joints. Obedient and durable.

engineering.name: Enchanted Bomb
engineering.description: Arcane-core bomb that detonates on intent rather than impact. The explosion has opinions.

engineering.name: Enchanted Turret
engineering.description: Arcane-powered turret that acquires targets before they know they're hostile.

engineering.name: Enchanted Gadget
engineering.description: Arcane-powered gadget that stretches the boundary between tool and companion.

engineering.name: Enchanted Automaton
engineering.description: Arcane-core automaton that anticipates commands. Something behind its eyes isn't quite mechanical.

engineering.name: Masterwork Bomb
engineering.description: Spirit-charged bomb machined from rare alloy. The blast discriminates between friend and target.

engineering.name: Masterwork Turret
engineering.description: Spirit-infused rare-alloy turret. It fires with prejudice and reloads with patience.

engineering.name: Masterwork Gadget
engineering.description: Spirit-essence gadget machined from rare alloy. It does what you need before you know you need it.

engineering.name: Masterwork Automaton
engineering.description: Spirit-infused automaton built from rare alloy. It pauses sometimes, as if thinking.

engineering.name: Mythic Bomb
engineering.description: Primordial explosive of divine engineering. Detonation rewrites the local geometry.

engineering.name: Mythic Turret
engineering.description: Primordial turret of divine engineering. It defends a position with the certainty of a natural law.

engineering.name: Mythic Gadget
engineering.description: Divine-metal gadget infused with primordial logic. The definition of 'tool' bends to accommodate it.

engineering.name: Mythic Automaton
engineering.description: Divine-metal automaton animated by primordial force. The line between construct and creature blurs.

farming.name: Basic Grain Sack
farming.description: A burlap sack of common grain. The foundation of bread, beer, and survival.

farming.name: Basic Fertilizer
farming.description: Composted scraps worked into usable amendment. The soil needs what the soil needs.

farming.name: Basic Seedling
farming.description: A fragile sprout nursed from common seed. Every orchard starts here.

farming.name: Basic Harvest Feast
farming.description: A humble spread of common field produce. Enough to share, enough to be grateful.

farming.name: Sturdy Grain Sack
farming.description: Enriched grain harvested from tended fields. Fuller kernels, better yield.

farming.name: Sturdy Fertilizer
farming.description: Enriched compost with mineral balance. Crops respond measurably.

farming.name: Sturdy Seedling
farming.description: A sturdy seedling raised from enriched stock. Roots already reaching.

farming.name: Sturdy Harvest Feast
farming.description: A generous feast from enriched harvests. The table groans, and morale follows.

farming.name: Enchanted Grain Sack
farming.description: Arcane-nurtured grain that stores longer than nature allows. Millers notice the difference.

farming.name: Enchanted Fertilizer
farming.description: Arcane-treated fertilizer that makes the ground receptive to things beyond ordinary agriculture.

farming.name: Enchanted Seedling
farming.description: An arcane-quickened seedling that grows visibly between dawn and dusk.

farming.name: Enchanted Harvest Feast
farming.description: An arcane-augmented feast that satisfies hungers the body forgot it had.

farming.name: Masterwork Grain Sack
farming.description: Spirit-fed grain from rare cultivar. The sack weighs more than it should—each kernel is dense with vitality.

farming.name: Masterwork Fertilizer
farming.description: Spirit-essence fertilizer that whispers to the roots. Growth becomes collaborative.

farming.name: Masterwork Seedling
farming.description: A spirit-touched rare seedling. The stem hums with unrealized potential.

farming.name: Masterwork Harvest Feast
farming.description: A spirit-blessed feast of rare produce. Guests leave stronger than they arrived.

farming.name: Mythic Grain Sack
farming.description: Primordial grain of divine agriculture. Ground into flour, it bakes bread that sustains beyond nutrition.

farming.name: Mythic Fertilizer
farming.description: Primordial fertilizer of divine composition. The ground accepts it like a sacrament.

farming.name: Mythic Seedling
farming.description: A primordial seedling of divine genesis. It grows toward something beyond sunlight.

alchemy_basic_catalyst.description: Ground herbs pressed into a reactive paste. It accelerates simpler reactions.

alchemy_basic_elixir.name: Basic Elixir
alchemy_basic_elixir.description: A thin, bitter liquid that barely qualifies as alchemy. Functional, if unremarkable.

alchemy_basic_potion.name: Basic Potion
alchemy_basic_potion.description: A cloudy vial of herb-water that soothes minor aches. Every alchemist starts here.

alchemy_basic_tonic.name: Basic Tonic
alchemy_basic_tonic.description: A crude tonic that tastes like wet grass. It works, barely.

alchemy_enchanted_catalyst.name: Enchanted Catalyst
alchemy_enchanted_catalyst.description: Arcane-infused catalyst that makes lesser reagents behave as though they were rare. Dangerous in careless hands.

alchemy_enchanted_elixir.name: Enchanted Elixir
alchemy_enchanted_elixir.description: Arcane resonance hums through every drop. The drinker feels the effect before it touches their lips.

alchemy_enchanted_potion.name: Enchanted Potion
alchemy_enchanted_potion.description: Spirit-flower essence stabilized with arcane dust. The liquid hums faintly when uncorked.

alchemy_enchanted_tonic.name: Enchanted Tonic
alchemy_enchanted_tonic.description: Spirit-flower and arcane dust produce a tonic that sharpens senses and steadies hands.

alchemy_masterwork_catalyst.name: Masterwork Catalyst
alchemy_masterwork_catalyst.description: Spirit essence bound into catalyst form. Other compounds bend around it like water around a stone.

alchemy_masterwork_elixir.name: Masterwork Elixir
alchemy_masterwork_elixir.description: Brewed from ancient roots and spirit essence, this elixir tastes like old forests and quiet power.

alchemy_masterwork_potion.name: Masterwork Potion
alchemy_masterwork_potion.description: Ancient roots surrendered their essence reluctantly for this brew. Drink carefully—the body remembers.

alchemy_masterwork_tonic.name: Masterwork Tonic
alchemy_masterwork_tonic.description: Ancient root tonic brewed to a formula only master alchemists dare attempt. Side effects vary.

alchemy_mythic_catalyst.name: Mythic Catalyst
alchemy_mythic_catalyst.description: Primordial forces compressed into a catalyst that treats natural law as a suggestion. Handle with reverence.

alchemy_mythic_elixir.name: Mythic Elixir
alchemy_mythic_elixir.description: The void bleeds into the glass. Primordial and rare essences merge into something that rewrites the drinker's limits.

alchemy_mythic_potion.name: Mythic Potion
alchemy_mythic_potion.description: Void-touched elixir distilled under conditions most alchemists consider suicidal. Heals what lesser draughts cannot.

alchemy_mythic_tonic.name: Mythic Tonic
alchemy_mythic_tonic.description: Void-essence tonic that pulses with primordial energy. The last tonic many alchemists ever need to make.

alchemy_sturdy_catalyst.name: Sturdy Catalyst
alchemy_sturdy_catalyst.description: Medicinal compounds refined into a stable catalyst. Reliable as a heartbeat.

alchemy_sturdy_elixir.name: Sturdy Elixir
alchemy_sturdy_elixir.description: Properly steeped medicinal herbs yield this dependable elixir. Worth more than its ingredients.

alchemy_sturdy_potion.name: Sturdy Potion
alchemy_sturdy_potion.description: A reliable restorative brewed from medicinal-grade herbs. Field medics swear by it.

alchemy_sturdy_tonic.name: Sturdy Tonic
alchemy_sturdy_tonic.description: Medicinal herbs steeped long enough to matter. A journeyman alchemist's bread and butter.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: Charcoal and bitter herb pressed into a tar-black liquid. It burns the poison out before it can settle.

aurora_flux.name: Aurora Flux
aurora_flux.description: Void essence braided with ancient root and prismatic powder. The drinker's veins glow briefly as body and mana knit themselves whole under elemental fury.

basic_glyph.name: Basic Glyph
basic_glyph.description: A stone tablet etched with arcane ink. The glyph emits a faint ward that makes the bearer marginally less killable.

blacksmithing_basic_armor.name: Basic Armor
blacksmithing_basic_armor.description: Crude iron plates riveted over leather. Protection measured in bruises avoided.

blacksmithing_basic_blade.name: Basic Blade
blacksmithing_basic_blade.description: Hammered iron sharpened on a whetstone. A beginner's weapon, but a weapon nonetheless.

blacksmithing_basic_shield.name: Basic Shield
blacksmithing_basic_shield.description: A flat iron slab with a leather strap. It stops what it can.

blacksmithing_basic_tool.name: Basic Tool
blacksmithing_basic_tool.description: A simple iron implement. It won't impress anyone, but it does the job.

blacksmithing_enchanted_armor.name: Enchanted Armor
blacksmithing_enchanted_armor.description: Mythril links woven with arcane binding. Light as resolve, hard as consequence.

blacksmithing_enchanted_blade.name: Enchanted Blade
blacksmithing_enchanted_blade.description: Mythril-forged and arcane-dusted, this blade seems to anticipate where it's swung.

blacksmithing_enchanted_shield.name: Enchanted Shield
blacksmithing_enchanted_shield.description: Mythril alloy reinforced with arcane dust. Blows land softer than physics should allow.

blacksmithing_enchanted_tool.name: Enchanted Tool
blacksmithing_enchanted_tool.description: Mythril-tipped and arcane-balanced. Work done with this tool feels less like labor.

blacksmithing_masterwork_armor.name: Masterwork Armor
blacksmithing_masterwork_armor.description: Adamantine plate kissed by spirit essence. Master smiths consider it their signature—or their tombstone.

blacksmithing_masterwork_blade.name: Masterwork Blade
blacksmithing_masterwork_blade.description: Adamantine and spirit essence fused under a master's hammer. The metal remembers violence and answers it.

blacksmithing_masterwork_shield.name: Masterwork Shield
blacksmithing_masterwork_shield.description: Adamantine-core shield infused with spirit essence. Arrows have been known to apologize mid-flight.

blacksmithing_masterwork_tool.name: Masterwork Tool
blacksmithing_masterwork_tool.description: Adamantine precision shaped by spirit essence. The tool almost seems to know what you need next.

blacksmithing_mythic_armor.name: Mythic Armor
blacksmithing_mythic_armor.description: Divine metal armor that reshapes itself around the wearer's intent. The primordial essence inside has opinions.

blacksmithing_mythic_blade.name: Mythic Blade
blacksmithing_mythic_blade.description: Divine metal folded with primordial essence. Legends rarely mention how many smiths died perfecting the technique.

blacksmithing_mythic_shield.name: Mythic Shield
blacksmithing_mythic_shield.description: Divine metal bonded with primordial force. The shield doesn't block attacks—it denies them permission.

blacksmithing_mythic_tool.name: Mythic Tool
blacksmithing_mythic_tool.description: Divine metal wrought into something that treats craftsmanship as a form of prayer. Primordial essence hums in the handle.

blacksmithing_sturdy_armor.name: Sturdy Armor
blacksmithing_sturdy_armor.description: Steel plate fitted by a competent hand. Not elegant, but your organs stay inside.

blacksmithing_sturdy_blade.name: Sturdy Blade
blacksmithing_sturdy_blade.description: Steel tempered in coal-fire. The edge holds through punishment that would shatter lesser metal.

blacksmithing_sturdy_shield.name: Sturdy Shield
blacksmithing_sturdy_shield.description: Steel-braced and properly weighted. A journeyman shield that earns trust through use.

blacksmithing_sturdy_tool.name: Sturdy Tool
blacksmithing_sturdy_tool.description: Steel-grade toolwork with a comfortable grip. Built to outlast its owner.

bread.name: Bread
bread.description: Flour and water shaped by heat into something that turns strangers into guests.

brewing_basic_ale.name: Basic Ale
brewing_basic_ale.description: Thin grain-ale that tastes like ambition and water. A brewer's first attempt.

brewing_basic_elixir.name: Basic Elixir
brewing_basic_elixir.description: A grain-based elixir barely distinguishable from flavored water. Progress starts somewhere.

brewing_basic_tonic.name: Basic Tonic
brewing_basic_tonic.description: Grain-based tonic with a medicinal aftertaste. Cheap and necessary.

brewing_basic_wine.name: Basic Wine
brewing_basic_wine.description: Grain pressed and fermented with more hope than skill. Barely qualifies as wine.

brewing_enchanted_ale.name: Enchanted Ale
brewing_enchanted_ale.description: Spirit-flower and arcane dust produce an ale that changes color as you drink it.

brewing_enchanted_elixir.name: Enchanted Elixir
brewing_enchanted_elixir.description: Arcane-laced elixir brewed from spirit-flower. The effect lingers longer than expected.

brewing_enchanted_tonic.name: Enchanted Tonic
brewing_enchanted_tonic.description: Arcane resonance laced through every drop. The body absorbs it before the tongue can object.

brewing_enchanted_wine.name: Enchanted Wine
brewing_enchanted_wine.description: Arcane-touched vintage that sparkles with trapped starlight. Sommeliers weep.

brewing_masterwork_ale.name: Masterwork Ale
brewing_masterwork_ale.description: Void essence steeped in aged barrels. The flavor profile exists in more dimensions than expected.

brewing_masterwork_elixir.name: Masterwork Elixir
brewing_masterwork_elixir.description: Void essence and spirit-infused elixir that tastes like standing in a thunderstorm. For the better.

brewing_masterwork_tonic.name: Masterwork Tonic
brewing_masterwork_tonic.description: Void-steeped tonic that recalibrates the drinker's stamina. Side effects include unsettling clarity.

brewing_masterwork_wine.name: Masterwork Wine
brewing_masterwork_wine.description: Void-essence wine aged beyond mortal patience. Each glass tastes like a memory you haven't made yet.

brewing_mythic_ale.name: Mythic Ale
brewing_mythic_ale.description: Divine nectar brewed with primordial patience. One sip rearranges the drinker's understanding of thirst.

brewing_mythic_elixir.name: Mythic Elixir
brewing_mythic_elixir.description: Divine nectar and primordial essence merge into an elixir that rewrites fatigue at the cellular level.

brewing_mythic_tonic.name: Mythic Tonic
brewing_mythic_tonic.description: Primordial tonic that treats exhaustion as a negotiable condition. Divine nectar demands respect.

brewing_mythic_wine.name: Mythic Wine
brewing_mythic_wine.description: Primordial vintage distilled from divine nectar. Drinking it is closer to communion than consumption.

brewing_sturdy_ale.name: Sturdy Ale
brewing_sturdy_ale.description: Fruit-fermented ale with enough body to warm a cold night's watch.

brewing_sturdy_elixir.name: Sturdy Elixir
brewing_sturdy_elixir.description: Fruit-derived elixir with a steadying warmth. Adventurers carry these like ritual.

brewing_sturdy_tonic.name: Sturdy Tonic
brewing_sturdy_tonic.description: Fruit-fermented tonic refined for potency. Keeps explorers on their feet.

brewing_sturdy_wine.name: Sturdy Wine
brewing_sturdy_wine.description: Fruit-wine with a clean finish. Popular at taverns that care about repeat customers.

butchery_basic_cured_meat.name: Basic Cured Meat
butchery_basic_cured_meat.description: Salt-rubbed meat hung to dry. Simple preservation for a simple road.

butchery_basic_jerky.name: Basic Jerky
butchery_basic_jerky.description: Thin-sliced meat dried over smoke. Trail food that demands nothing and delivers enough.

butchery_basic_ration.name: Basic Ration
butchery_basic_ration.description: Compressed meat and grain pressed into a block. It sustains; it does not inspire.

butchery_basic_sausage.name: Basic Sausage
butchery_basic_sausage.description: Rough-ground meat stuffed into casing. Don't ask questions; eat it.

butchery_enchanted_cured_meat.name: Enchanted Cured Meat
butchery_enchanted_cured_meat.description: Exotic meat treated with arcane salt. The preservation borders on unnatural.

butchery_enchanted_jerky.name: Enchanted Jerky
butchery_enchanted_jerky.description: Arcane-smoked exotic jerky that sustains beyond what nutrition explains.

butchery_enchanted_ration.name: Enchanted Ration
butchery_enchanted_ration.description: Arcane-preserved exotic rations that stay fresh longer than trust.

butchery_enchanted_sausage.name: Enchanted Sausage
butchery_enchanted_sausage.description: Exotic meat sausage laced with arcane spice. Hunger remembers this and behaves.

butchery_masterwork_cured_meat.name: Masterwork Cured Meat
butchery_masterwork_cured_meat.description: Dragon steak cured with spirit essence. The meat resists spoilage like it resists everything else.

butchery_masterwork_jerky.name: Masterwork Jerky
butchery_masterwork_jerky.description: Dragon-strip jerky infused with spirit essence. Chewing it feels like an argument you're winning.

butchery_masterwork_ration.name: Masterwork Ration
butchery_masterwork_ration.description: Dragon-meat rations wrapped in spirit essence. They weigh less than they should and last longer than they have any right to.

butchery_masterwork_sausage.name: Masterwork Sausage
butchery_masterwork_sausage.description: Dragon-meat sausage bound with spirit essence. The filling has an opinion about being eaten.

butchery_mythic_cured_meat.name: Mythic Cured Meat
butchery_mythic_cured_meat.description: Divine flesh preserved through primordial technique. It tastes like a covenant.

butchery_mythic_jerky.name: Mythic Jerky
butchery_mythic_jerky.description: Divine flesh jerky touched by primordial fire. Each strip holds more sustenance than a full meal of lesser meat.

butchery_mythic_ration.name: Mythic Ration
butchery_mythic_ration.description: Divine-flesh rations infused with primordial staying power. An army could march on these until the world ended.

butchery_mythic_sausage.name: Mythic Sausage
butchery_mythic_sausage.description: Divine flesh sausage packed with primordial seasoning. Every bite is an event.

butchery_sturdy_cured_meat.name: Sturdy Cured Meat
butchery_sturdy_cured_meat.description: Prime cuts cured with care and time. Keeps longer, tastes better, costs more.

butchery_sturdy_jerky.name: Sturdy Jerky
butchery_sturdy_jerky.description: Prime jerky with a peppered bite. Reliable fuel for long marches.

butchery_sturdy_ration.name: Sturdy Ration
butchery_sturdy_ration.description: Prime rations packed for extended campaigns. Reliable as gravity.

butchery_sturdy_sausage.name: Sturdy Sausage
butchery_sturdy_sausage.description: Prime meat sausage seasoned with intent. The casing holds better things now.

construction_basic_gate.name: Basic Gate
construction_basic_gate.description: A timber gate held by iron hinges. It swings open and closed—the rest is up to you.

construction_basic_tower.name: Basic Tower
construction_basic_tower.description: A timber watchtower. It gives you height and a better view of approaching problems.

construction_basic_wall.name: Basic Wall
construction_basic_wall.description: Timber stacked and nailed. It keeps weather out and little else.

construction_basic_workshop.name: Basic Workshop
construction_basic_workshop.description: A timber shed with a workbench. Ambition required; space provided.

construction_enchanted_gate.name: Enchanted Gate
construction_enchanted_gate.description: Arcane-warded gate of reinforced brick. Unauthorized entry triggers consequences.

construction_enchanted_tower.name: Enchanted Tower
construction_enchanted_tower.description: Reinforced brick tower humming with arcane ward-lines. Threats are spotted before they're visible.

construction_enchanted_wall.name: Enchanted Wall
construction_enchanted_wall.description: Reinforced brick fused with arcane dust. The wall shifts subtly to distribute force.

construction_enchanted_workshop.name: Enchanted Workshop
construction_enchanted_workshop.description: Arcane-reinforced workshop where materials behave more predictably than they should.

construction_masterwork_gate.name: Masterwork Gate
construction_masterwork_gate.description: Enchanted masonry gate sealed with spirit essence. Opening it requires permission, not force.

construction_masterwork_tower.name: Masterwork Tower
construction_masterwork_tower.description: Enchanted masonry spire saturated with spirit essence. The tower sees what sentries miss.

construction_masterwork_wall.name: Masterwork Wall
construction_masterwork_wall.description: Enchanted masonry bonded with spirit essence. Battering rams break before this does.

construction_masterwork_workshop.name: Masterwork Workshop
construction_masterwork_workshop.description: Enchanted masonry workshop flooded with spirit-tuned air. Projects finish faster inside these walls.

construction_mythic_gate.name: Mythic Gate
construction_mythic_gate.description: Void-structure gateway infused with primordial authority. Only passage granted by intent can cross its threshold.

construction_mythic_tower.name: Mythic Tower
construction_mythic_tower.description: Void-structure tower anchored in primordial geometry. Distance becomes negotiable from its apex.

construction_mythic_wall.name: Mythic Wall
construction_mythic_wall.description: Void-structure wall threaded with primordial will. It exists more firmly than the ground beneath it.

construction_mythic_workshop.name: Mythic Workshop
construction_mythic_workshop.description: Void-structure workshop stabilized by primordial forces. The laws of materials bend gently to accommodate the crafter's will.

construction_sturdy_gate.name: Sturdy Gate
construction_sturdy_gate.description: Stone-framed gate with reinforced crossbar. Keeps honest threats honest.

construction_sturdy_tower.name: Sturdy Tower
construction_sturdy_tower.description: Stone-block tower built for permanence. Archers love the sightlines.

construction_sturdy_wall.name: Sturdy Wall
construction_sturdy_wall.description: Stone-block wall with mortar joints. Siege engineers treat these with respect.

construction_sturdy_workshop.name: Sturdy Workshop
construction_sturdy_workshop.description: Stone-block workshop with ventilation and tool racks. Craft improves when the workspace doesn't fight you.

cooking_basic_dessert.name: Basic Dessert
cooking_basic_dessert.description: Sweet scraps shaped into something that passes for celebration. Morale counts.

cooking_basic_meal.name: Basic Meal
cooking_basic_meal.description: Rough-cut meat charred over flame. Nourishment without pretense.

cooking_basic_skewer.name: Basic Skewer
cooking_basic_skewer.description: Chunks of meat impaled on a stick and held over fire. Tradition at its simplest.

cooking_basic_stew.name: Basic Stew
cooking_basic_stew.description: Meat boiled until tenderness surrenders. Simple, hot, honest.

cooking_enchanted_dessert.name: Enchanted Dessert
cooking_enchanted_dessert.description: Arcane-sweetened confection that lingers on the tongue and sharpens the senses.

cooking_enchanted_meal.name: Enchanted Meal
cooking_enchanted_meal.description: Arcane-spiced fare that satisfies hungers the body didn't know it had.

cooking_enchanted_skewer.name: Enchanted Skewer
cooking_enchanted_skewer.description: Arcane-marinated skewers that crackle with residual heat long after leaving the fire.

cooking_enchanted_stew.name: Enchanted Stew
cooking_enchanted_stew.description: Arcane-seasoned stew that warms from the inside and lingers long after the bowl is empty.

cooking_masterwork_dessert.name: Masterwork Dessert
cooking_masterwork_dessert.description: Spirit-essence dessert made from rare herbs. Sweetness with consequences.

cooking_masterwork_meal.name: Masterwork Meal
cooking_masterwork_meal.description: Rare herbs and spirit essence folded into a meal that restores more than strength.

cooking_masterwork_skewer.name: Masterwork Skewer
cooking_masterwork_skewer.description: Rare herb–basted skewers infused with spirit essence. The char carries flavor into the soul.

cooking_masterwork_stew.name: Masterwork Stew
cooking_masterwork_stew.description: Spirit-touched stew brewed from rare herbs. The aroma alone has restorative properties.

cooking_mythic_dessert.name: Mythic Dessert
cooking_mythic_dessert.description: Divine confection touched by primordial sugar. The taste outlives the meal by hours.

cooking_mythic_meal.name: Mythic Meal
cooking_mythic_meal.description: Divine-flesh cuisine prepared with primordial technique. Eating it is an experience that redefines sustenance.

cooking_mythic_skewer.name: Mythic Skewer
cooking_mythic_skewer.description: Divine-flesh skewers glazed with primordial reduction. Every bite echoes.

cooking_mythic_stew.name: Mythic Stew
cooking_mythic_stew.description: Divine flesh simmered in primordial broth. Each spoonful fills something deeper than the stomach.

cooking_sturdy_dessert.name: Sturdy Dessert
cooking_sturdy_dessert.description: Prime ingredients assembled into a dessert worth rationing. A treat between battles.

cooking_sturdy_meal.name: Sturdy Meal
cooking_sturdy_meal.description: Prime cuts prepared with care. A meal worth coming home to.

cooking_sturdy_skewer.name: Sturdy Skewer
cooking_sturdy_skewer.description: Prime meat skewered and flame-kissed. Quick to prepare, satisfying to eat.

cooking_sturdy_stew.name: Sturdy Stew
cooking_sturdy_stew.description: Prime ingredients slow-cooked into a stew that makes cold camps bearable.

dyeing_basic_dye.name: Basic Dye
dyeing_basic_dye.description: Crude pigment mixed from common sources. The color holds until the first hard rain.

dyeing_basic_finish.name: Basic Finish
dyeing_basic_finish.description: A basic topcoat of dye that protects against scuffing. Modest in purpose.

dyeing_basic_glamour.name: Basic Glamour
dyeing_basic_glamour.description: A thin veneer of dye that adds a hint of color. Cosmetic, not transformative.

dyeing_basic_pattern.name: Basic Pattern
dyeing_basic_pattern.description: A simple repeating motif stitched or stamped with basic dye. Recognizable, if unremarkable.

dyeing_enchanted_dye.name: Enchanted Dye
dyeing_enchanted_dye.description: Prismatic pigment fused with arcane dust. The dye shifts hue depending on the light—and the viewer's intent.

dyeing_enchanted_finish.name: Enchanted Finish
dyeing_enchanted_finish.description: Prismatic finish bonded with arcane dust. The surface repels grime and hostile scrutiny.

dyeing_enchanted_glamour.name: Enchanted Glamour
dyeing_enchanted_glamour.description: Prismatic glamour enhanced with arcane shimmer. The wearer looks more expensive than they are.

dyeing_enchanted_pattern.name: Enchanted Pattern
dyeing_enchanted_pattern.description: Prismatic pattern woven with arcane precision. It catches the eye and refuses to let go.

dyeing_masterwork_dye.name: Masterwork Dye
dyeing_masterwork_dye.description: Illusion dust bound with spirit essence into a dye that remembers every color it has ever been.

dyeing_masterwork_finish.name: Masterwork Finish
dyeing_masterwork_finish.description: Illusion-dust finish sealed by spirit essence. The coating adapts to conditions others can't predict.

dyeing_masterwork_glamour.name: Masterwork Glamour
dyeing_masterwork_glamour.description: Illusion-dust glamour fused with spirit essence. Onlookers remember the impression, not the details.

dyeing_masterwork_pattern.name: Masterwork Pattern
dyeing_masterwork_pattern.description: Illusion-dust pattern layered with spirit essence. The motif appears to move when observed closely.

dyeing_mythic_dye.name: Mythic Dye
dyeing_mythic_dye.description: Divine radiance distilled into pigment. The color applied is less a choice and more a statement of cosmic preference.

dyeing_mythic_finish.name: Mythic Finish
dyeing_mythic_finish.description: Divine-radiance finish over primordial sealant. The surface exists in a state of curated perfection.

dyeing_mythic_glamour.name: Mythic Glamour
dyeing_mythic_glamour.description: Divine-radiance glamour infused with primordial presence. The wearer commands attention without speaking.

dyeing_mythic_pattern.name: Mythic Pattern
dyeing_mythic_pattern.description: Divine-radiance pattern sealed with primordial authority. The design tells a story that changes for every observer.

dyeing_sturdy_dye.name: Sturdy Dye
dyeing_sturdy_dye.description: Metallic pigment ground and set with fixative. Colors that survive what the wearer survives.

dyeing_sturdy_finish.name: Sturdy Finish
dyeing_sturdy_finish.description: Metallic-pigment finish with a durable sheen. Weatherproof and presentable.

dyeing_sturdy_glamour.name: Sturdy Glamour
dyeing_sturdy_glamour.description: Metallic-pigment glamour that lends armor and cloth a polished authority.

dyeing_sturdy_pattern.name: Sturdy Pattern
dyeing_sturdy_pattern.description: Metallic-pigment pattern with clean geometry. Signals competence before the wearer speaks.

enchanting_basic_charm.name: Basic Charm
enchanting_basic_charm.description: Arcane-ink charm with a single-purpose enchantment. Modest, but it works.

enchanting_basic_rune.name: Basic Rune
enchanting_basic_rune.description: Arcane ink pressed into a simple shape. The rune holds barely enough power to matter.

enchanting_basic_sigil.name: Basic Sigil
enchanting_basic_sigil.description: A faint arcane-ink sigil that warns more than it protects. A starting point.

enchanting_basic_ward.name: Basic Ward
enchanting_basic_ward.description: A basic arcane-ink ward scratched into a surface. It discourages; it does not prevent.

enchanting_enchanted_charm.name: Enchanted Charm
enchanting_enchanted_charm.description: Soul-gem charm radiating arcane warmth. The enchantment adjusts subtly to its bearer.

enchanting_enchanted_rune.name: Enchanted Rune
enchanting_enchanted_rune.description: Soul gem carved into a rune that pulses with arcane awareness. It knows when it's needed.

enchanting_enchanted_sigil.name: Enchanted Sigil
enchanting_enchanted_sigil.description: Soul-gem sigil pulsing with arcane authority. Hostile magic hesitates at its border.

enchanting_enchanted_ward.name: Enchanted Ward
enchanting_enchanted_ward.description: Soul-gem ward fused with arcane dust. Attacks that reach it lose their conviction.

enchanting_masterwork_charm.name: Masterwork Charm
enchanting_masterwork_charm.description: Void-essence charm fused with spirit resonance. The charm seems to anticipate what the wearer will face.

enchanting_masterwork_rune.name: Masterwork Rune
enchanting_masterwork_rune.description: Void essence channeled into a master-grade rune. The inscription seems to watch back.

enchanting_masterwork_sigil.name: Masterwork Sigil
enchanting_masterwork_sigil.description: Void-essence sigil drawn with spirit precision. The mark burns cold in the presence of danger.

enchanting_masterwork_ward.name: Masterwork Ward
enchanting_masterwork_ward.description: Void-essence ward reinforced by spirit binding. Breaching it costs more than most aggressors can afford.

enchanting_mythic_charm.name: Mythic Charm
enchanting_mythic_charm.description: Primordial charm of divine craftsmanship. The enchantment woven into it predates the jeweler's intent.

enchanting_mythic_rune.name: Mythic Rune
enchanting_mythic_rune.description: Primordial rune etched with divine intent. Reality treats the marked surface differently.

enchanting_mythic_sigil.name: Mythic Sigil
enchanting_mythic_sigil.description: Primordial sigil of divine geometry. The pattern existed before the surface it's drawn on.

enchanting_mythic_ward.name: Mythic Ward
enchanting_mythic_ward.description: Primordial ward sealed with divine authority. What it protects stays protected until the ward decides otherwise.

enchanting_sturdy_charm.name: Sturdy Charm
enchanting_sturdy_charm.description: Elemental-shard charm that hums quietly against the skin. Steady, reliable enhancement.

enchanting_sturdy_rune.name: Sturdy Rune
enchanting_sturdy_rune.description: Elemental shard ground into rune-form. The inscription flickers with contained force.

enchanting_sturdy_sigil.name: Sturdy Sigil
enchanting_sturdy_sigil.description: Elemental-shard sigil with sharp lines of contained power. Respectable ward-work.

enchanting_sturdy_ward.name: Sturdy Ward
enchanting_sturdy_ward.description: Elemental-shard ward with layered defensive geometry. Adequate protection for moderate threats.

engineering_basic_automaton.name: Basic Automaton
engineering_basic_automaton.description: A crude articulated figure of scrap metal. It follows basic instructions, mostly.

engineering_basic_bomb.name: Basic Bomb

minor_mana_potion.description: Spirit-flower petals dissolved in still water. The faint shimmer restores a wisp of spent mana.

mythril_blade.name: Mythril Blade
mythril_blade.description: Five mythril ingots and enchanted leather produce a blade that cuts reality a little thinner than iron ever could.

mythril_ingot.name: Mythril Ingot
mythril_ingot.description: Mythril ore refined with spirit essence. The bar weighs less than it should and hums when struck.

portal_creation_basic_anchor_stone.name: Basic Anchor Stone
portal_creation_basic_anchor_stone.description: A heavy stone with a carved spatial marker. It stays put while everything else moves.

portal_creation_basic_gate_sigil.name: Basic Gate Sigil
portal_creation_basic_gate_sigil.description: A scratched sigil that opens a narrow spatial slit. Step through before it changes its mind.

portal_creation_basic_portal_rune.name: Basic Portal Rune
portal_creation_basic_portal_rune.description: A crude spatial rune scratched into stone. The rift it opens flickers and complains.

portal_creation_basic_waypoint_seal.name: Basic Waypoint Seal
portal_creation_basic_waypoint_seal.description: A simple wax seal marking a spatial coordinate. It holds position, barely.

portal_creation_enchanted_anchor_stone.name: Enchanted Anchor Stone
portal_creation_enchanted_anchor_stone.description: An arcane anchor stone that hums with ley-line awareness. Spatial calculations simplify around it.

portal_creation_enchanted_gate_sigil.name: Enchanted Gate Sigil
portal_creation_enchanted_gate_sigil.description: An arcane gate sigil that opens portals with precise destination control.

portal_creation_enchanted_portal_rune.name: Enchanted Portal Rune
portal_creation_enchanted_portal_rune.description: An arcane portal rune that broadcasts its position across ley-lines. Finding it is the easy part.

portal_creation_enchanted_waypoint_seal.name: Enchanted Waypoint Seal
portal_creation_enchanted_waypoint_seal.description: An arcane waypoint seal that bends distance. The other side is closer than it looks.

portal_creation_masterwork_anchor_stone.name: Masterwork Anchor Stone
portal_creation_masterwork_anchor_stone.description: A spirit-essence anchor stone that resists dimensional turbulence. Fixed in ways solid rock cannot match.

portal_creation_masterwork_gate_sigil.name: Masterwork Gate Sigil
portal_creation_masterwork_gate_sigil.description: A spirit-charged gate sigil that opens passages most travelers cannot perceive.

portal_creation_masterwork_portal_rune.name: Masterwork Portal Rune
portal_creation_masterwork_portal_rune.description: A spirit-essence portal rune carved from rare crystal. It persists through dimensional interference.

portal_creation_masterwork_waypoint_seal.name: Masterwork Waypoint Seal
portal_creation_masterwork_waypoint_seal.description: A spirit-sealed waypoint connecting distant locations. The passage remembers who travels it.

portal_creation_mythic_anchor_stone.name: Mythic Anchor Stone
portal_creation_mythic_anchor_stone.description: A primordial anchor stone of divine permanence. It exists as the spatial origin point for everything nearby.

portal_creation_mythic_gate_sigil.name: Mythic Gate Sigil
portal_creation_mythic_gate_sigil.description: A primordial gate sigil of divine resonance. Doors that don't exist yet open when it's activated.

portal_creation_mythic_portal_rune.name: Mythic Portal Rune
portal_creation_mythic_portal_rune.description: A primordial portal rune of divine fixation. It defines 'here' with absolute authority.

portal_creation_mythic_waypoint_seal.name: Mythic Waypoint Seal
portal_creation_mythic_waypoint_seal.description: A primordial waypoint seal of divine architecture. Distance, time, and possibility negotiate at its threshold.

portal_creation_sturdy_anchor_stone.name: Sturdy Anchor Stone
portal_creation_sturdy_anchor_stone.description: An elemental-shard anchor stone with stable resonance. Portals reference it without drift.

portal_creation_sturdy_gate_sigil.name: Sturdy Gate Sigil
portal_creation_sturdy_gate_sigil.description: An elemental-shard gate sigil with clean aperture. Reliable short-range transit.

portal_creation_sturdy_portal_rune.name: Sturdy Portal Rune
portal_creation_sturdy_portal_rune.description: An elemental-shard rune with stable spatial resonance. Portals lock onto it reliably.

portal_creation_sturdy_waypoint_seal.name: Sturdy Waypoint Seal
portal_creation_sturdy_waypoint_seal.description: An elemental-shard waypoint seal with reliable lock. Short-range transit made dependable.

repair_basic_polish.name: Basic Polish
repair_basic_polish.description: Rough abrasive and elbow grease. The surface improves, grudgingly.

repair_basic_reinforcement.name: Basic Reinforcement
repair_basic_reinforcement.description: Extra strapping and bracing applied to weak points. Functional support at minimum cost.

repair_basic_repair_kit.name: Basic Repair Kit
repair_basic_repair_kit.description: Scrap material and binding wire packed into a rough kit. It holds until something better comes along.

repair_basic_restoration.name: Basic Restoration
repair_basic_restoration.description: Basic cleaning and realignment. Restores enough function to keep going.

repair_enchanted_polish.name: Enchanted Polish
repair_enchanted_polish.description: Arcane polish that bonds at the molecular level. The surface becomes stronger than virgin metal.

repair_enchanted_reinforcement.name: Enchanted Reinforcement
repair_enchanted_reinforcement.description: Arcane-grade reinforcement that integrates with the item's structure. Stronger than a fresh forge.

repair_enchanted_repair_kit.name: Enchanted Repair Kit
repair_enchanted_repair_kit.description: An arcane repair kit that diagnoses damage before the crafter does. The tools guide the hands.

repair_enchanted_restoration.name: Enchanted Restoration
repair_enchanted_restoration.description: Arcane restoration that reverses wear at a level deeper than surface damage.

repair_masterwork_polish.name: Masterwork Polish
repair_masterwork_polish.description: Spirit-charged polish from rare compounds. The treated surface gains properties the original lacked.

repair_masterwork_reinforcement.name: Masterwork Reinforcement
repair_masterwork_reinforcement.description: Spirit-fitted rare-alloy reinforcement that merges with the item's original purpose.

repair_masterwork_repair_kit.name: Masterwork Repair Kit
repair_masterwork_repair_kit.description: A spirit-infused rare-alloy repair kit. The materials choose their own placement for optimal restoration.

repair_masterwork_restoration.name: Masterwork Restoration
repair_masterwork_restoration.description: Spirit-infused restoration from rare materials. The item remembers being well-made and returns to that state.

repair_mythic_polish.name: Mythic Polish
repair_mythic_polish.description: Primordial polish of divine metallurgy. The metal forgets every scratch it ever received.

repair_mythic_reinforcement.name: Mythic Reinforcement
repair_mythic_reinforcement.description: Primordial reinforcement of divine-grade material. The item evolves past its original design limits.

repair_mythic_repair_kit.name: Mythic Repair Kit
repair_mythic_repair_kit.description: A primordial repair kit of divine completeness. It doesn't fix items—it convinces them they were never broken.

repair_mythic_restoration.name: Mythic Restoration
repair_mythic_restoration.description: Primordial restoration of divine thoroughness. The item's history of use is erased and its potential rewritten.

repair_sturdy_polish.name: Sturdy Polish
repair_sturdy_polish.description: Quality polish compound that restores luster and protects against future wear.

repair_sturdy_reinforcement.name: Sturdy Reinforcement
repair_sturdy_reinforcement.description: Quality reinforcement plates and bindings. The item regains—and exceeds—its original durability.

repair_sturdy_repair_kit.name: Sturdy Repair Kit
repair_sturdy_repair_kit.description: Alloy patches and bonding compound in an organized case. The repair outlasts the original where it overlaps.

repair_sturdy_restoration.name: Sturdy Restoration
repair_sturdy_restoration.description: Full restoration with quality materials. The item regains its factory condition.

scroll_of_light.name: Scroll of Light
scroll_of_light.description: Parchment and light-ink shaped into a spell that can be spoken three times before the words fade. Darkness, briefly, becomes optional.

simple_meal.name: Simple Meal

skinning_basic_hide_armor.name: Basic Hide Armor

skinning_basic_leather.name: Basic Leather
skinning_basic_leather.description: Common hide tanned to basic serviceability. Stiff, but workable.

skinning_basic_pelt.name: Basic Pelt
skinning_basic_pelt.description: Fur and skin dried in sun. It insulates and little else.

skinning_basic_trophy.name: Basic Trophy
skinning_basic_trophy.description: A cleaned fang, claw, or bone. Proof of a kill; memory of a hunt.

skinning_enchanted_hide_armor.name: Enchanted Hide Armor
skinning_enchanted_hide_armor.description: Arcane-treated exotic hide armor that flexes with the wearer and hardens on impact.

skinning_enchanted_leather.name: Enchanted Leather
skinning_enchanted_leather.description: Arcane-cured exotic leather that moves like a second skin.

skinning_enchanted_pelt.name: Enchanted Pelt
skinning_enchanted_pelt.description: An arcane-cured exotic pelt that regulates temperature regardless of climate.

skinning_enchanted_trophy.name: Enchanted Trophy
skinning_enchanted_trophy.description: An arcane-preserved exotic trophy that radiates faint menace. Visitors notice it first.

skinning_masterwork_hide_armor.name: Masterwork Hide Armor
skinning_masterwork_hide_armor.description: Rare-beast hide armor sealed with spirit essence. The armor remembers how the creature survived.

skinning_masterwork_leather.name: Masterwork Leather
skinning_masterwork_leather.description: Spirit-steeped rare leather with self-mending properties. Damage heals if you wait.

skinning_masterwork_pelt.name: Masterwork Pelt
skinning_masterwork_pelt.description: A spirit-preserved rare pelt. The fur moves as though something still lives in it.

skinning_masterwork_trophy.name: Masterwork Trophy
skinning_masterwork_trophy.description: A spirit-sealed rare-creature trophy. It frightens things that should know better.

skinning_mythic_hide_armor.name: Mythic Hide Armor
skinning_mythic_hide_armor.description: Primordial hide armor of divine creature origin. Wearing it changes the wearer's relationship with damage.

skinning_mythic_leather.name: Mythic Leather
skinning_mythic_leather.description: Primordial leather of divine origin. It wears the crafter's intentions like a garment of its own.

skinning_mythic_pelt.name: Mythic Pelt
skinning_mythic_pelt.description: A primordial pelt of divine creature origin. Wrapping in it changes the wearer's relationship with the cold.

skinning_mythic_trophy.name: Mythic Trophy
skinning_mythic_trophy.description: A primordial trophy of divine creature origin. The creature's power lingers in its remains.

skinning_sturdy_hide_armor.name: Sturdy Hide Armor
skinning_sturdy_hide_armor.description: Quality hide armor shaped and hardened. Affordable defense that doesn't embarrass.

skinning_sturdy_leather.name: Sturdy Leather
skinning_sturdy_leather.description: Quality leather tanned from superior stock. Supple and durable.

skinning_sturdy_pelt.name: Sturdy Pelt
skinning_sturdy_pelt.description: A trophy-grade pelt cleaned and preserved. Warm, presentable, valuable.

skinning_sturdy_trophy.name: Sturdy Trophy
skinning_sturdy_trophy.description: A mounted trophy from quality game. It commands respect on the wall.

soulforged_helmet.name: Soulforged Helmet
soulforged_helmet.description: Adamantine plate shaped around a soul gem. The wearer hears a faint whisper that might be protection—or might be something older.

steel_ingot.name: Steel Ingot
steel_ingot.description: Iron and coal married under terrible heat. The resulting steel holds an edge worth respecting.

steel_sword.name: Steel Sword
steel_sword.description: A proper weapon of folded steel and leather grip. Soldiers kill for less.

stormbrand_enchant.name: Stormbrand Enchant
stormbrand_enchant.description: Mythril blade wired with lightning core and soulthread. The enchantment doesn't just add damage—it makes the weapon angry.

tailoring_basic_bag.name: Basic Bag
tailoring_basic_bag.description: Rough cloth stitched into a carry-all. It holds more than it should and complains about none of it.

tailoring_basic_cloak.name: Basic Cloak
tailoring_basic_cloak.description: Rough-cut cloth shaped into a cloak. It keeps rain off and questions away.

tailoring_basic_gloves.name: Basic Gloves
tailoring_basic_gloves.description: Cloth gloves that protect against splinters and little else.

tailoring_basic_robe.name: Basic Robe
tailoring_basic_robe.description: Rough cloth stitched into a garment. It fits, and modesty is preserved.

tailoring_enchanted_bag.name: Enchanted Bag
tailoring_enchanted_bag.description: Arcane-silk bag that adjusts its interior to fit the contents. Spatial efficiency as textile craft.

tailoring_enchanted_cloak.name: Enchanted Cloak
tailoring_enchanted_cloak.description: Arcane-silk cloak that adjusts its drape to ambient magical conditions.

tailoring_enchanted_gloves.name: Enchanted Gloves
tailoring_enchanted_gloves.description: Arcane-silk gloves that enhance tactile precision beyond human limits.

tailoring_enchanted_robe.name: Enchanted Robe
tailoring_enchanted_robe.description: Arcane-woven silk robe that shimmers with residual enchantment. Mages wear these like armor.

tailoring_masterwork_bag.name: Masterwork Bag
tailoring_masterwork_bag.description: Spirit-silk bag woven with essence thread. The interior is larger than the exterior admits.

tailoring_masterwork_cloak.name: Masterwork Cloak
tailoring_masterwork_cloak.description: Spirit-silk cloak woven with essence threads. The fabric darkens in danger and lightens in safety.

tailoring_masterwork_gloves.name: Masterwork Gloves
tailoring_masterwork_gloves.description: Spirit-silk gloves woven with essence. The wearer's hands remember skills before the mind recalls them.

tailoring_masterwork_robe.name: Masterwork Robe
tailoring_masterwork_robe.description: Spirit-silk robe threaded with essence. The fabric responds to the wearer's magical output.

tailoring_mythic_bag.name: Mythic Bag
tailoring_mythic_bag.description: Primordial bag of divine weave. It contains what its owner needs before they know they need it.

tailoring_mythic_cloak.name: Mythic Cloak
tailoring_mythic_cloak.description: Primordial cloak of divine weave. Observers forget the wearer's face before they finish looking.

tailoring_mythic_gloves.name: Mythic Gloves
tailoring_mythic_gloves.description: Primordial gloves of divine weave. What the hands touch, the hands understand—completely and permanently.

tailoring_mythic_robe.name: Mythic Robe
tailoring_mythic_robe.description: Primordial robe of divine textile. The garment exists in a state of constant, subtle evolution.

tailoring_sturdy_bag.name: Sturdy Bag
tailoring_sturdy_bag.description: Quality-linen bag with reinforced seams and organized compartments. A traveler's reliable companion.

tailoring_sturdy_cloak.name: Sturdy Cloak
tailoring_sturdy_cloak.description: Quality-linen cloak with a weighted hem. Moves with purpose, dries with speed.

tailoring_sturdy_gloves.name: Sturdy Gloves
tailoring_sturdy_gloves.description: Quality-linen gloves with reinforced fingertips. Grip and comfort.

tailoring_sturdy_robe.name: Sturdy Robe
tailoring_sturdy_robe.description: Quality-linen robe with reinforced seams. Comfortable and road-worthy.
